question: The term ‘square leg’ is related to which of the following games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• 'Square leg' is a fielding position in the sport of cricket.
 
• This position is on the leg side (left side of a right-handed batsman) of the field.
 
• The player at square leg typically stands perpendicular to the batsman, near the boundary line.
 
• This position is crucial for catching and stopping shots that are played on the leg side.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fielding Positions in Cricket**

 
 
• Other fielding positions include slip, gully, cover, mid-off, mid-on, and fine leg.
 
• Fielding positions are strategic and vary depending on the bowler and batsman.
 
 
 
• **Cricket Basics**
 
 
• Cricket is played between two teams of eleven players each.
 
• The game involves batting, bowling, and fielding, with the primary objective being to score more runs than the opposing team.
 
 
 
• **Formats of Cricket**
 
 
• Cricket is played in various formats, including Test matches, One Day Internationals (ODIs), and Twenty20 (T20) matches.
 
• Each format has different rules, durations, and strategies.
 
 
 
• **Cricket Governing Bodies**
 
 
• The International Cricket Council (ICC) is the global governing body for cricket.
 
• National cricket boards manage the sport within their respective countries, like the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).
